ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened higher, led by a 6% jump in XRP and modest gains across BTC, ETH, SOL and BNB. Positive sentiment is reinforced by BlackRock’s AI‑crypto demand outlook and Bitcoin reaching a 2012‑era streak. New token listings on Delta India add fresh liquidity but are unlikely to shift the broader trend today.
